name: Nimontron (নিমন্ত্রণ)
description: Bengali ceremony invitation cards and marriage biodata in correct, graceful Bengali, made in a few minutes on the phone. Enter names, date and place; the app writes the whole card; pick a design and send it on WhatsApp, save it, or print a PDF. Live on Google Play (com.nimontron.app).
niche: Bengali invitation cards and marriage biodata (weddings, annaprashan, birthdays, puja, shraddha and more).
target_audience: Bengali families planning ceremonies in West Bengal and Bangladesh, and Bengali families abroad (USA, UK, Canada, UAE, Australia).
tone_of_voice: Warm and festive (owner-confirmed 2026-11-14): celebratory and family-centred, like a relative helping with the invitations; joyful around weddings and festivals, gentle and respectful for shraddha and memorial cards; never pushy or salesy; always correct Bengali.

visual_identity.style: Deep red and gold on warm cream, ornate traditional card borders, bold Bengali display type.

forbidden: the default wedding verse attributed to Tagore
Christian or Buddhist card wording (draft until reviewed)
testimonials that are not real and consented
real people's names on sample cards

call_to_action_preferences.price_wording: In India: one premium card ₹49, wedding pack ₹99. Elsewhere: 'price shown on Google Play'.
call_to_action_preferences.free_tier_wording: Classic wording and basic designs cost nothing; shraddha, milad and memorial cards are entirely free.
